points: Send a welcome email with times
Tell the team who is starting
steps.tip: A welcome email ends first-day nerves before they start.

steps.title: Welcome and tour
points: Show the kitchen, toilets and exits
steps.tip: Pick a buddy who is not their manager.

steps.title: Tools and access
steps.tip: Keep a written list of tools so nothing is missed.

steps.title: A first real task
steps.q: young man working laptop office focused
points: Clear who to ask for help
steps.tip: Finishing something on day one feels great.

steps.title: End-of-day check-in
points: Share the plan for the week
steps.tip: Ten minutes at 4:30 sets the tone for the whole internship.
